{{recipe}} 

Cumin and Monterrey Jack cheese add a nice Mexican kick to plain chicken. Your kids will love this recipe.

== Ingredients ==
*4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
*[[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinches]] freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] shredded [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterrey Jack cheese]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] both sides of chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and 1 pinch of cumin.
#Place in a large roasting pan and insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into one of the breasts. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the center of a 400°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
#Remove and sprinkle with cheese. Place back in oven until cheese is melted.
#Serve warm.
